cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Prove Your Loyalty
cards.instruction: Invent small tests of loyalty and judge every response without admitting there is a test.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Could you keep Friday free? I might need help moving.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've promised to help Alex paint.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Right. Paint takes priority. Could you at least leave your phone on?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Of course. Have you actually found a flat?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Still looking. Nice that I'm worth a charged battery. This is just planning.

mechanism: A grants permission for competing plans while grading small offers of availability as evidence of loyalty without naming the test.
confusable: A practical scheduling request would accept useful contact arrangements; this pair must judge their personal value from an assumed superior position.
comparison: A speculative move tests friendship availability rather than public image ranking and committee fairness.
seedUse: Use D11-b unconfirmed move, Alex commitment and charged phone; S01 makes exemptions and contact access subject to A approval.
